_meta.source: data.gov.my fuel price weekly API (id=fuelprice) — updated daily via scripts/update_fuel_prices.py

fuel.note: Pump prices = what consumers pay: RON95 RM2.05 (SKPS-subsidized), diesel RM2.10 (BUDI); RON97 RM4.15 unsubsidized market. Raw market levels in market_rm_per_l. Price week: 2026-08-13.

co2_factors.note: grid (default/peninsular): Peninsular Malaysia generation mix average (2025, ~2024 TNB + independent power producers). by_region.east_malaysia is an ESTIMATE blending hydro-dominant Sarawak (Bakun/Murum/Batang Ai, ~0.2 kg/kWh) with gas/diesel Sabah (~0.5 kg/kWh), weighted to Sarawak's larger generation share. Replace with a sourced SEB/SESB figure when one is available.
